'''Steve Skilton''' (forum handle '''stevetotheizz0''') developed the [[Limited Resources Format]] in 2020.<ref name="pc-debut">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/narp-friendly-limited-resources-format-debuts-on-gemp/ NARP-Friendly "Limited Resources" Format Debuts on Gemp], Players Committee (19 December 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210117113105/https://www.starwarsccg.org/narp-friendly-limited-resources-format-debuts-on-gemp/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="t76030">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=76030 Alt format: Limited Resources Format Now LIVE on GEMP], forum.starwarsccg.org (stevetotheizz0, 31 July 2020; page 1). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025003633/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t76030.html Internet Archive].</ref> He played the [[2017 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ 2017 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
